heading: Appendix C Creative banks and exact treatment addressing
intro: The following banks were materialized from the 10 October 2026 catalogue and are preserved here as usable text. They remain proposals. The catalogue's earlier statement that a second film was in progress and that zero twelve-style slots were qualified is a historical assembly snapshot; it is not today's completed-film ledger. This guide does not retroactively mark individual catalogue recipes rendered because a similarly named film exists.

paragraphs: There are 240 underlying premises, 120 learning and 120 fiction, and 2,400 addressable candidate treatments. There were zero independently written complete treatment scripts, zero catalogue recipe renders and zero audience studies in that catalogue. Factual checkability is not factual verification. Lexically distinct ideas are not proven novel against all historical work. Select one premise for a concrete viewer task, resolve its facts and rights, write an actual storyboard and test its risky action.
The four representation approaches are below. Their original pipeline wording is a historical candidate status. Current installed/used evidence is in the main architecture and tool sections.

records.construction: Use original articulated line characters, crisp props and explicit highlights. Keep one causal relationship legible at a time.
records.communicative_difference: Emphasizes symbolic relationships, exact matching and readable cause/effect without depth distractions.
records.gate: Rig contacts, text layout and every diagram relationship must be checked; this is 2D animation.

records.construction: Stage the same action as a drawn field-note sequence. Add traces, section views and short observations in the order they are needed.
records.communicative_difference: Makes reasoning and uncertainty visible through progressive construction, rather than presenting only the final state.
records.gate: Verify stroke order, annotation tracking and model limits. Rough strokes must never change factual geometry.

records.construction: Build the scene with original volumetric props and grounded characters, then use lighting, contact and a restrained camera to show the same conflict.
records.communicative_difference: Emphasizes embodied effort, occlusion and spatial consequences that the diagrammatic view abstracts.
records.gate: Requires a real 3D scene, alternate-angle check, contact/shadow review and source reopening. Blockbench is a research-only asset option.

records.construction: Create original foreground, character, prop and background planes with meaningful depth order. Use gentle parallax, grounded articulation and explicit masks to stage the existing story.
records.communicative_difference: Emphasizes layered attention, a rich setting and a gradual foreground/background discovery while retaining the readability of illustration.
records.gate: This is 2.5D, not true volumetric 3D. Check masks, disocclusion gaps, foot anchors, occlusion order, scene-space transforms and every texture license.

intro: The stable ID is `R-{story_id}-{format_id}-{approach_id}`. Each story receives exactly ten rows. The four groups below preserve every actual format/approach/intro/motion assignment without copying hundreds of thousands of words of repeated template prose. Join the story record with its format, approach, intro and motion records in this same file. A compatible combination is still not a screenplay.
editorial_rules: F01 explains the relationship through the story's visible action and bounded takeaway.
F02 asks the story question before a fair thinking hold, then resolves it from visible evidence. It is excluded from the public-safety group.
F03 separates one worked case into setup, action and a checked checkpoint.
F04 compares initial and changed conditions while isolating one justified variable; no invented counterfactual result.
F05 starts at the outcome, inspects clues, then replays the supported chain forward without overstating causality.
F06 stages a want, obstacle, committed choice, consequence and the authored ending.
F07 makes the costs of two plausible choices visible; an unexecuted alternate branch stays labeled proposed.
F08 gives the viewer a fair advance clue before the protagonist notices it; no last-second coincidence.
F09 lets readable actions and reactions carry the story with sparse captions and purposeful sound.
F10 retells the same conflict from an existing prop/helper viewpoint without inventing a new solution.
F20 alternates schematic and tangible representations of one relationship. Practical guidance needs an approved factual script first.
editorial_rules_after: Learning combinations fail if their comparison has no controlled basis, their backward trace overstates causality, or factual verification removes the premise. Fiction combinations fail if their alternative choice, advance clue or object viewpoint requires a contrived new premise rather than illuminating the existing one. Every combination inherits the story risks, format gate, approach gate, rights review, caption readability, motion comfort, audio mix and exact-byte checks.

records.gate: Show a single causal chain and state model limits.

records.structure: A want, obstacle, choice, consequence and closing image.
records.gate: A lesson is a theme, not evidence for a general factual claim.

records.structure: The protagonist faces two costs and commits to one path.

records.gate: Check denominator, scope, date and interpolation.

records.structure: The same mechanism alternates between schematic and tangible views.
records.gate: Keep correspondences exact and disclose simplifications.

records.definition: Looks straight down without perspective convergence.
records.use: Routes, layouts, traffic toys, mazes and procedural systems.
records.check: Do not infer object height from a top view; label scale if meaningful.

records.definition: Action is staged along a clear horizontal or vertical plane.
records.use: Character movement, levers, elevators and sequence lessons.
records.check: Keep contacts visible and avoid accidental depth cues.

records.definition: A parallel-projection view exposes several axes at once.
records.use: Workshops, city systems and compact multi-station stories.
records.check: Use consistent projection and disclose decorative scale choices.

records.definition: A camera sees the scene from a character-like vantage point.
records.use: Embodied travel, obstacles, effort and cinematic story scenes.
records.check: Maintain lens, horizon and spatial continuity.

records.definition: Two or more cameras show the same state and moment.
records.use: Geometry checks, assembly, ambiguous silhouettes and mechanism teaching.
records.check: Synchronize time, object identity and scale references.

records.definition: Paths, shapes and articulated planar characters.
records.use: Crisp causal diagrams and expressive economical stories.
records.check: A pan or shadow does not turn it into volumetric 3D.

records.definition: Cutouts occupy declared depth planes and move with parallax.
records.use: Rich illustrated worlds, motion comics and quiet emotional scenes.
records.check: Inspect masks and disoccluded gaps; depth is approximate.

records.definition: True volumes use deliberately visible polygonal faces.
records.use: Toy terrain, expeditions and readable block-world action.
records.check: Check real geometry and alternate angles; faceting is not a color filter.

records.definition: Modeled surfaces, real cameras, lights and object depth.
records.use: Tactile characters, turntables and spatial mechanism stories.
records.check: Check normals, contact, silhouette and native reopening.

records.definition: A true volume is cut or separated to expose its relationships.
records.use: Product anatomy, architecture and machinery explanations.
records.check: The section plane and part relationships must be geometrically valid.

records.definition: Fibers, layered edges and soft cut-paper shadows.
records.use: Editorial stories, maps and tactile explanation.
records.check: Use original/procedural or individually cleared textures.

records.definition: Soft fibers, stitched seams and diffuse light.
records.use: Warm characters, care stories and miniature objects.
records.check: Texture alone is not cloth simulation; verify deformations if claimed.

records.definition: Soft sculpted forms, roughness and designed deformation.
records.use: Character comedy, fables and tactile transformation.
records.check: Label rendered clay-style work accurately; inspect volume preservation.

records.definition: Grainy strokes and drawn construction marks.
records.check: Keep geometry, text and contrast legible despite texture.

records.definition: Distinct grain, glaze or specular response.
records.check: Match lighting to material; do not claim physical authenticity.

records.definition: An individually cleared image contributes surface or setting detail.
records.check: Review each source's rights, provenance and spatial limits.

records.definition: Restrained detail, explicit labels and clear relationships.
records.check: A technical look does not establish factual accuracy.

records.definition: Small original worlds, grounded characters and intentional light.
records.use: Cooperation, everyday microdrama and gentle adventure.
records.check: Preserve a complete story rather than only attractive scenery.

records.definition: Bold shapes, hatching, print texture and deliberate framing.
records.use: Editorial learning and compact visual storytelling.
records.check: Do not use texture or busy outlines to hide weak action.

records.definition: Lighting, depth and camera timing support mood.
records.check: Readable action and honest source evidence remain required.

records.definition: One main action with a small supporting diagram or label.
records.check: Keep the evidence readable and do not let the host cover it.

records.definition: Two states or views share one timeline.
records.check: State what changes and what is held fixed.

records.definition: A grid displays distinct views or moments.
records.use: Character sheets, object inspection and perspective puzzles.
records.check: Limit panels to phone-readable content; label moments versus viewpoints.

records.definition: The main object remains visible beside an internal view.
records.check: Keep the inset tied to the same exact object and state.

records.definition: Actual source contributions separate into inspectable passes.
records.use: Production teaching and reusable component review.
records.check: Count only active meaningful contributions; do not double-count nested groups.

records.material: Clean paths with optional original paper texture
records.why: The frontier and waiting queue stay visible together, so search order can be checked.
records.check: Verify every visited node, legal edge and queue operation.

records.material: Paper silhouettes or original textured objects
records.why: Footprints and retrieval paths are legible without perspective distortion.
records.check: Verify dimensions, occupied area and the specific retrieval rule.

records.material: Crisp lines and restrained chalk labels
records.why: Intervals can be counted without visual depth confusing the starting point.
records.check: Check signed arithmetic and keep the same unit spacing.

records.material: Ink on an original textured stage
records.why: The changing distance to the ribbon and the character’s strategy stay readable.
records.check: Check foot contact, ribbon continuity and the earned resolution.

records.material: Original cut-paper raincoat and background textures
records.why: Gentle parallax and a visible background gesture support the emotional reveal.
records.check: Inspect cutout halos, disocclusion gaps, grounding and clue visibility.

records.why: The nested planes make shelter and belonging tangible without requiring a full 3D model.
records.check: Do not call it true 3D; inspect camera limits and texture rights.

records.geometry: True 3D or explicitly labeled 2D isometric drawing
records.why: Parallel stations and the narrow gate can be inspected at the same time.
records.check: Distinguish projection from geometry and verify rates and queue counts.

records.material: Original block materials with soft practical light
records.why: Visible polygon facets and a coordinated wave make scale and sequence readable.
records.check: Check geometry, consistent lights, nonflashing timing and the propagation rule.

records.why: The character’s size, occlusion and route create embodied spatial stakes.
records.check: Establish scale, inspect contacts and keep the fictional crossing coherent.

records.material: Original paper fibers and restrained glow
records.layout: One shared lantern through several hands
records.why: Material and handoff staging emphasize cooperation while keeping the token identifiable.
records.check: Review every texture, hand contact, glow boundary and light-sensitive cue.

records.layout: Close action then resolved wide frame
records.why: Stitches and soft material make the act of care tangible.
records.check: Texture is not cloth simulation. Check seams, deformation and asset rights.

records.why: Weight, hesitation and small deformations communicate intention.
records.check: Preserve volume, contact and intentional timing.

records.why: Progressive drawing separates the disturbance from the motion of individual elements.
records.check: Check the actual model and ensure texture does not change element positions.

records.why: Multiple angles expose a mesh that a single flattering view could hide.
records.check: Check tooth engagement, ratios, shared time and native/source reopening.

records.geometry: True 3D or four independently authored consistent 2D views
records.why: This is multi-faceted as multiple perspectives, distinct from polygonal faceting.
records.check: Verify the puzzle answer and phone-size visibility in every panel.

records.why: The viewer can connect the outside motion to the hidden joining mechanism.
records.check: Match the inset to the same state and verify mechanism claims.

records.geometry: Exact vector plan and matching 3D blocks
records.why: The plan supports counting while the spatial view supports intuition.
records.check: Verify identical perimeters, areas, units and source geometry.

records.view: Two matched character views and a final wide view
records.why: Different viewpoints withhold different information until the whole is visible.
records.check: Keep artwork original, identities consistent and the final reveal earned.

top_picks.heading: Original top twenty editorial picks
intro: These are the catalogue's historical editorial recommendations, not current owner-approved selections or guaranteed watchable stories. Reapply the latest comedy/suspense gate.

records.title: The Half-Platform Problem
records.original_reason: Equivalent fractions can be seen directly. A fixed reference rail makes the central comparison easy to inspect.
records.proposed_first_version: Two original platform tiles slide onto one shared unit rail. Use a brief prediction, the reveal and a clear final hold.
records.gate: Check all lengths and subdivisions mathematically. Keep one reference whole throughout.

records.title: The Runaway Finish Line
records.original_reason: A moving finish line is immediately understandable and gives the character a clear change of strategy.
records.proposed_first_version: Articulated line runner, readable ribbon motion and three restrained camera setups. Finish on the quiet step through the anchored ribbon.
records.gate: Check ribbon continuity, original character design and a safe cartoon tone.

records.title: The Gear Neighbors Turn Apart
records.original_reason: Meshing neighbors supply a compact visible mechanism that is also useful for testing synchronized rotation.
records.proposed_first_version: Two large labeled gears first, then one additional gear. Use a clean diagram before considering a tactile 3D version.
records.gate: Check tooth engagement, rotation direction and gear-ratio claims. A decorative mesh is insufficient.

records.title: The Lantern Relay
records.original_reason: The lantern gives a natural visual focus, a warm ending and a reusable handoff animation.
records.proposed_first_version: A short chain of characters passes one original lantern through a richly staged scene. Keep the handoff visible.
records.gate: Preserve object identity, contacts and lighting. Use fictional safe props rather than fire-handling instruction.

records.title: The Basement Delivery
records.original_reason: The mistaken count is small, concrete and can be demonstrated without a complex asset set.
records.proposed_first_version: An elevator travels on a clearly mathematical number line while a second counter exposes the off-by-one error.
records.gate: Verify the signed arithmetic. Explain that floor labels are a model rather than a real building standard.

records.title: The Polite Bowling Ball
records.original_reason: A polite bowling ball can show intention through timing and trajectory without elaborate dialogue.
records.proposed_first_version: Use one ball, a few original characters and a simple stage. Let hesitation and courteous detours carry the comedy.
records.gate: Keep the physics visibly fictional where necessary and make the final objective readable.

records.title: The Maze With a Waiting Line
records.original_reason: A queue-based search can become a real visual trace rather than a vague coding analogy.
records.proposed_first_version: Use one fixed maze, a visible waiting queue and an identified search token. Reveal the visited frontier in order.
records.gate: Check the algorithm trace, legal connections and stopping rule against a deterministic reference.

records.title: Across the Breakfast Canyon
records.original_reason: An everyday tabletop seen at miniature scale gives rich spatial stakes with a small reusable prop set.
records.proposed_first_version: Build an original breakfast landscape. Establish scale, track the traveler and resolve the crossing with an earned choice.
records.gate: Label the scene as fiction, check route continuity and avoid risky real-world imitation cues.

records.title: The Stripe Compressor Meets Confetti
records.original_reason: Compressible stripes and noisy confetti make the difference in repeated structure visible.
records.proposed_first_version: Show the same encoding rule applied to two small patterns. Keep a compact symbol count beside the action.
records.gate: State the exact simplified encoding. Verify counts and avoid claiming all real compressors behave identically.

records.title: Two Ends of the Map
records.original_reason: Split map knowledge supports a clear cooperation story and a useful matched-view composition.
records.proposed_first_version: Start with each character holding one map portion. Reveal the combined route through shared action.
records.gate: Keep the map geometry consistent and ensure cooperation, rather than a lucky coincidence, resolves the obstacle.

records.title: The Narrowest Gate
records.original_reason: A narrow gate is a tangible way to introduce a bottleneck and show why local speed is not enough.
records.proposed_first_version: Animate tokens through three stations, change only the intended capacity, and show the resulting queue.
records.gate: Define the toy process, rates and measurement interval. Do not generalize its result to every workplace.

records.title: The Caption That Lost the Speaker
records.original_reason: Speaker attribution in captions creates a practical accessibility lesson that can be shown directly.
records.proposed_first_version: Use two original voices or labeled characters. Compare ambiguous captions with a clearly attributed version.
records.gate: Verify caption conventions and readable timing. Do not rely on color alone for speaker identity.

records.title: The Block City Night Wave
records.original_reason: A city-wide night wave offers a satisfying visual payoff and reusable timing controls.
records.proposed_first_version: A miniature block city passes one intentional evening signal from place to place. Let the camera reveal the larger pattern slowly.
records.gate: Check the actual causal or fictional rule and avoid flashing lights or excessive brightness changes.

records.title: Same Fence, Different Garden
records.original_reason: Equal fence length and different garden area create an inspectable geometric contrast.
records.proposed_first_version: Rearrange the same boundary pieces into two original plots, then tile their interiors using a shared unit.
records.gate: Verify perimeter and area independently. Keep units and any grid scale explicit.

records.title: The Three-Lamp Switch Dance
records.original_reason: A finite lamp puzzle supports a real answer-checking fixture as well as an episode.
records.proposed_first_version: Show the legal switch action, allow a fair prediction, then reveal the verified sequence in a calm repeat.
records.gate: Exhaustively verify reachable states and the claimed solution. Avoid misleading electrical-wiring realism.

records.title: The Drawer That Counts Footprints
records.original_reason: A drawer layout turns vague tidiness into a visible fit and access problem.
records.proposed_first_version: Use accurately sized original silhouettes on an overhead tray. Show why a visually compact layout may obstruct retrieval.
records.gate: Check dimensions and the chosen access rule. Present one example, not a universal organizing prescription.

records.title: The Finite Spring Finale
records.original_reason: A finite spring mechanism creates a built-in ending and a useful limit to the action.
records.proposed_first_version: Show the stored-motion setup, a short sequence of consequences and the calm state after the energy is spent.
records.gate: Keep it a fictional prop. If making real mechanics claims, validate the energy accounting and safe boundaries.

records.title: The Giant Three-Point Jump
records.original_reason: A truncated chart can produce a strong before/after reveal without a large scene.
records.proposed_first_version: Show the exact same three data points with two clearly labeled axis ranges, then inspect the apparent difference.
records.gate: Use explicitly illustrative data, preserve the values and label axes. Do not manufacture an empirical claim.

records.title: The Traveling Pulse
records.original_reason: A traveling pulse can separate movement of a disturbance from movement of the material.
records.proposed_first_version: Use marked elements in a visible row. Track a few elements while the pulse travels through the group.
records.gate: Check the model and boundary conditions. Do not generalize one wave type to all waves.

records.title: The Flood Shortcut Stays Off the Map
records.original_reason: A calm preparedness episode fits the survival/learning direction and avoids turning danger into a guessing game.
records.proposed_first_version: After source approval, use a clearly labeled map illustration to explain why the proposed flood shortcut is removed.
records.gate: Hold production until current authoritative flood-safety guidance is checked for the intended region. Do not stage a traversable flood-depth challenge.
